summary: @apicity/meta ships known-bad dropper host litter.catbox.moe used in TanStack supply-chain campaign
details: The package's dist/src/example.js references litter.catbox.moe, an anonymous file-hosting endpoint used as the second-stage dropper host in the TanStack npm supply-chain compromise. litter.catbox.moe is a mutable, anonymous host serving attacker-controlled payloads and has no legitimate role in a published npm package's runtime code path. The package's scope and use of this known-bad infrastructure fingerprint is consistent with the dropper pattern from that campaign, in which the installed package fetches and executes a second-stage payload from this host, leading to code execution in the installer's environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
